jobs.jobDescription: A full-stack developer builds and maintains both the front-end (what users see) and back-end (server, database logic) of websites and applications, handling everything from user interface design with HTML/CSS/JavaScript to database management (SQL/NoSQL) and server-side coding (Python, Node.js), effectively managing the entire development lifecycle for a seamless, functional product.
jobs.aboutCompany: TVK Technology is a Chennai-based IT firm specializing in training, outsourcing, and digital transformation, offering job-ready skills in Cloud, DevOps, Data Analytics, Digital Marketing, and Software Development, with a strong focus on free internships for freshers and placement support for MNCs, aiming to bridge the industry skill gap
